questions.question: What are the five parts of a classic story arc?

points.text: Exposition (introduction), Rising Action (complications), Climax (turning point), Falling Action (consequences), Resolution (conclusion).

questions.question: What does "in medias res" mean and why is it effective?

points.text: "In medias res" means starting in the middle of the action. It's effective because it immediately grabs the reader's attention and creates intrigue from the first line.

questions.question: Name two ways to reveal character without directly stating traits.

points.text: Through dialogue (how they speak), through actions (what they do), through reactions (how they respond to events), through interactions with others, through telling details of appearance or behaviour.

questions.question: What is the difference between first person and third person narrative voice?

points.text: First person uses "I" and is limited to the narrator's perspective, creating intimacy. Third person uses "he/she/they" and can be more flexible, showing multiple perspectives or maintaining distance.

questions.question: Rewrite this weak opening to be more engaging: "One day I went to the shops and something happened."

points.text: Example: "The shops were the last place I wanted to be on a Tuesday. But that was before I saw the man in the grey coat watching me from across the street."
